description: Warm brown, deep and steady, catching the light with a subtle richness.
Deep hazel, shifting between green and brown depending on the angle of light.
Soft amber, luminous and honey-tinted, with a gentle warmth at the center.
Warm honey-brown, smooth and expressive, like sunlit wood grain.
Forest green, deep and calm, with faint darker flecks throughout the iris.
Soft moss-green, muted and earthy, with a quiet, grounded quality.
Warm blue, clear and open, carrying a gentle brightness without being cold.
Soft grey-blue, hazy and thoughtful, like a cloudy morning sky reflected in still water.
Deep chestnut, rich and dark, with barely-there auburn undertones visible up close.
Warm olive-green, mellow and earthy, blending soft brown and green in equal measure.
Warm brown, rich and steady, with a gentle golden shimmer near the pupil.
Deep hazel, shifting between earthy green and soft amber in different light.
Soft amber, honeyed and luminous, catching warmth like sunlit resin.
Warm honey-brown, smooth and inviting, with faint toffee-colored rings toward the edge.
Forest green, deep and calm, flecked with subtle threads of darker olive near the iris rim.
